title: Catchment areas
rule: No one may cut, fell, damage or remove trees or forest produce from catchment areas on general land. More broadly, harvesting, grazing, cultivation and mining are banned in areas of catchment or watershed value, except for forest management.
points: Having timber, mineral or agricultural produce presumed illegally obtained from a catchment forest is an offence against the Regulations.
The produce is confiscated and becomes Government property.
